verdict.rationale: Adyen documents issuing a virtual card through the API by creating a paymentInstrument resource of type Virtual, but only after an account holder and a balance account already exist, so issuance is not a true one-call flow. Card details (PAN, CVC, expiry) are documented only as a reveal to cardholders through the iOS SDK, not as server-side data returned at issuance, and nothing shows a self-serve path from sandbox to a live card. Missing for 10: PAN/CVV/expiry returned programmatically at creation, a single-call flow without prerequisite resources, and evidence of going live without a sales cycle.
